thread:
deploy-bot: Migration agent picked up migration '2026-03-add_user_email_idx' and acquired schema lock (lease=lease-88f3). Quiet window reserved 01:15-01:35 UTC. Rolling out in 2 minutes. @jen chao please ack.
jen chao: acked. I'll monitor index build and tail pg_stat_activity.
omar r: what's estimated exclusive lock time?
lin (db): depends on rows scanned; if we hit >45s lock we'll abort and fall back to per-tenant indexer. Plan B ready.
samir: prepping rollback pin and service-route rollback script. Will keep old index snapshot name: users_email_idx_v1.
qa-mary: smoke tests queued, healthchecks ready at https://ci.internal/quick-smoke/123 :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Starting phase 1: acquire lock and create index concurrently fallback check. Logs: 
```
[00:00:02] BEGIN; -- lock attempt
[00:00:03] LOCK TABLE users IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE; -- got lock
[00:00:04] CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY users_email_idx_v2 ON users (email) WHERE email IS NOT NULL;
```
 (note: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY still needs a brief SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE, but we use a controlled window)
omar r: seeing a spike in waiting queries on replica, 12 waiting backends. ETA to finish?
lin (db): index already scanned ~28% in 18s, but waiters at 60s will start to cascade. If >30s more, abort.
samir: readying route-pin command: `scripts/pin-service-version --to 1.2.3` (this will prevent new writepad migrations).
jen chao: can we warm-fail to read-only on a subset? we should avoid user-facing errors.
lin (db): we can't fully avoid short tails. Trigger threshold: if lock hold >75s from now -> abort.
deply-bot: (typo) sorry, deploy-bot: Observability alert: p90 db wait time increased to 420ms, connections 210/250.
qa-mary: smoke started, first pass green. continuing.
omar r: still seeing replication lag climb to 4s. If it hits >10s we should kill.
jen chao: on-call is watching. @samir ready to pin if I say go?
samir: ready.
lin (db): 58s elapsed, index at 53%. Wait queues growing. Recommend pause and evaluate.
jen chao: pause applied. deploy-bot: pausing index creation is not supported, we need to choose: continue with risk, or cancel and run tenant-wise backfill. Thoughts?
omar r: cancel. fallback path is safer.
samir: initiating rollback hatch: running `kubectl set image deploy/web web=web:1.2.3 --namespace prod` and starting internal rollback playbook.
jen chao: confirming abort migration. I'm going to send cancel to deploy agent.
deply-bot: (again) deploy-bot: Received abort request for migration '2026-03-add_user_email_idx'. Releasing lock lease=lease-88f3. Starting cleanup of partial state.
lin (db): confirm `DROP INDEX IF EXISTS users_email_idx_v2;` queued on maint connection to avoid leftover partial index artifacts.
qa-mary: post-abort smoke run started, linking results: https://ci.internal/quick-smoke/124 (running)
omar r: replication lag falling back to <1s, connections normalizing.
samir: pin complete, traffic routed back to 1.2.3, feature flag to skip index-enabled path toggled off.
jen chao: good job everyone. Action items: 1) reschedule migration in smaller tenant-chunked window, 2) add earlier detection for wait-queue growth at 30s, 3) rehearse tenant-index backfill runbook. I'll open a follow-up doc. :memo: 
deploy-bot: Migration '2026-03-add_user_email_idx' aborted by jen chao (reason: wait-queue surge). Rollback completed at 01:22:45 UTC.
jen chao: closing thread, will post follow-up doc & new schedule. :wave:
